messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — SkylineHealth private VPC onboarding scheduled Wed 3/5 10:00 PT. Need network + IAM + KMS + audit logs signoff before kickoff. Olga, can you confirm VPC CIDRs, KMS key ARN, and audit bucket? cc @Ethan @Priya
Ethan (SE): Copy. For network I need: VPC CIDR, whether peering is via TGW or direct peer, who manages NAT, and if they use shared services. Also if they have proxy egress rules.
Olga (Skyline): VPC is 10.20.0.0/16. We'll peer via TGW (us-west-2). Customer-managed NAT gateway in public subnets. KMS key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh-1234. Key rotation: 30d.
Priya (Oncall): Network notes: open outbound 443 only to our endpoints. SSH (22) should be blocked except from jumpbox IPs. We'll need SG + NACL confirmations. Also need a list of CIDR blocks for allowed egress: right now placeholder egress IPs 13.58.22.101, 13.58.22.102 — I'll provide the full set by EOD Tue.
Maya (CSM): Olga — audit logs: bucket name + retention? Also who should be IAM admins (emails) so we can wire up cross-account roles correctly. We'll capture in the onboarding playbook.
Olga (Skyline): Audit bucket: skyline-prod-logs, retention 365 days. IAM admins: olga@skyline.com, infra-team@skyline.com. We need a short auditor-friendly summary of retention + access controls.
Ethan (SE): For KMS and IAM, here's a minimal policy snippet for the cross-account role that allows decrypt with the provided key:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/redwood-inference-role"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh-1234"
    }
  ]
}
```
DeployBot: Readiness check results: network=partial (missing full egress list + SG rules), kms=ok, iam=partial (need role ARNs + admin emails), audit_logs=ok (bucket exists). See /deploy/records/1738200000.
Maya (CSM): Quick risk callout — renewal in 11 months. If onboarding slips >3 weeks we should flag at renewal review. Recommend getting NAT/TGW confirmation and IAM admin list this week.
Olga (Skyline): Can you provide a 1-pager for our auditors describing log retention, KMS key access, and who has access to the bucket? We need to show that during our compliance review next month.
Maya (CSM): Yes — I'll draft the 1-pager after we lock details. Proposed next actions:
- Ethan: share terraform / minimal IAM snippets (today)
- Priya: publish final egress IP list + SG rule template (Tue EOD)
- Olga: confirm admin emails + attach bucket policy (today)
Kickoff remains Wed 3/5 10:00 PT unless blockers appear.
Ethan (SE): :thumbsup: attaching a minimal role policy example for the cross-account assume-role:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOnboardRole",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"sts:ExternalId": "skyline-onboard-2025"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
Priya (Oncall): I'll run a firewall connectivity test next Tue morning and post the results here. Will include sample tcpdump + curl to our health endpoint for verification.
Olga (Skyline): Awesome thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team — I'll update the onboarding doc and link it here when ready. :white_check_mark:
